name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: In Darkshire, Clerk Daltry matches the recovered handwriting to Stalvan Mistmantle. His report makes the Night Watch's suspicion certain.

sections.title: A Match in the Records
sections.body: Back in Darkshire's town hall, Clerk Daltry compares the bloodstained journal page with signatures in the Town Registry. The handwriting matches Stalvan Mistmantle exactly. After the trail led through manors, inns, and civic records across the human kingdoms, the Night Watch now has proof that the danger is close at hand.

sections.title: The Night Watch's Suspicions
sections.body: Commander Althea Ebonlocke has feared Stalvan from the beginning. Duskwood already faces feral worgen, skeletal undead, and lurking necromancers. She cannot ignore another danger: an unaccounted-for murderer in the woods. Daltry's confirmation sets the Night Watch on a course to find Stalvan and stop him for good.

faq.answer: Clerk Daltry compared the bloodstained journal page with signatures in Darkshire's Town Registry. The handwriting matched Stalvan Mistmantle exactly, as Commander Ebonlocke suspected.

faq.q: Why does Commander Althea Ebonlocke care so much about Stalvan?
faq.answer: Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads the Night Watch, Darkshire's beleaguered militia. With terrors already threatening the land, she cannot leave a violent, shadowy figure with a dark past loose and unaccounted for in Duskwood.

faq.q: Where does this step take place?
faq.answer: This step takes place entirely within Darkshire. Clerk Daltry is in the town hall, while Commander Althea Ebonlocke patrols nearby on the town's central roads.

faq.q: What happens after reporting the handwriting match?
faq.answer: After Clerk Daltry confirms the match, the investigation turns to hunting for Stalvan's whereabouts in Duskwood's haunted wilds.

Stalvan Mistmantle once taught at the Moonbrook schoolhouse and later tutored the Flintridge family's children privately. His letters and journal pages lead from Moonbrook and Goldshire back to Duskwood, where he lives as a dangerous recluse in the woods.

Events and accusations about Stalvan span Moonbrook and Goldshire, so official records are scattered. Darkshire's civic registry holds verified local samples that can definitively tie those foreign clues to this specific man.

angles.text: For Alliance investigators, Stalvan's trail shows how Darkshire's battered leaders and wandering adventurers must work together to keep the southern territories secure.
As a human, you see your society's decay in respected tutors and rural towns slipping from civilization into madness and isolation.
